Author: Tarun

At 3:14 AM, NovaVault, India's largest cryptocurrency exchange, was breached. ₹50 crore disappeared. DCP Kabir Sharma assigns you, Agent Arjun Mehra, to investigate the case.

Agent Mehra was off-duty that night. Remote access was active. DCP Sharma has provided you with an encrypted message that may contain the credentials needed to access the investigation system. Recover the message and uncover what lies behind it.
